remarks_1999: Not recorded Whitney Archive, Abiquiú Notebooks. Downtown Gallery Archive dates 1925. Inscription in museum files: "Large Dark Red Leaves on White – 1925/by Georgia O'Keeffe/$6000/Price $" (Alfred Stieglitz, An American Place2, black ink). Inscription in museum files dates 1925. Dated 1927 on basis of stretcher inscription, similarity to cat. no. 605, and inclusion in 1928 exhibition. (Source: Lynes, 1999)
remarks_post_1999: The Lynes publication lists *Large Dark Red Leaves on White* as the primary title. The primary title has been changed to privilege the inscription on the original stretcher, *Autumn Leaves No. 2*,  over information from the later American Place label, which seems to have informed the Downtown Gallery label. (Source: Georgia O'Keeffe Museum, 2026)

description: Reddish brown leaves span the length and width of the composition, dominating the image. They cast blue shadows on the rippling white surface that constitutes the painting's background.
